description: Instructional airframe at the Tredu vocational college aviation campus at Pirkkala. Recorded flight time 4892 hours.
Pressurised Navajo used as an instructional airframe at Tredu Pirkkala. Previously N910PS.

Ex-Finnish Air Force Chieftain used as an instructional airframe at Tredu Pirkkala. Also carried the civil registration OH-PAV. One index page titles this airframe PC-6 which conflicts with its own identity line.
Instructional airframe at Tredu. Carried many previous registrations across the United States and Europe.
aliases: N569BW; F-GIFP; SE-DHK; N45WH; N212H; N4118F; Mystere 20
